theorem_title: One subsequence controlling every local conjugate
formal_statement:
theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.localCompactness : ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N),
  AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M →
    AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ResiduesFinite M → AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.LocalCompactness M := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Shinichi Mochizuki, *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*, February 2009.

Official PDF: https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Arithmetic%20Elliptic%20Curves%20in%20General%20Position.pdf

Local PDF: `/home/admin-wsl/Coq/abc/refer/Mochizuki/Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position.pdf`

SHA-256: `b9dc115af61dca7fe434332ebafddf6a376a9e2926dad4e1ea2dcc0d2441f768`

Proof of Theorem 2.1, printed page 12 / PDF page 12. The requested pointer around p. 13 resolves to p. 12 in this version; page 13 continues with the height inequalities.

Primary compactness passage:

> Let $V \subseteq \mathbb{V}(\mathbb{Q})$ be a finite subset that contains $\mathbb{V}(\mathbb{Q})^{\mathrm{arc}}$ and [the subset of $\mathbb{V}(\mathbb{Q})^{\mathrm{non}}$ determined by] $\Sigma$. Then it follows immediately from the compactness of the set of rational points of $X$ over any finite extension of $\mathbb{Q}_v$ for $v \in V$ that there exists a subset $\Xi \subseteq X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})^{=d}$, together with a(n) [unordered] $d$-tuple of points $\Xi_v$ of $X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}_v)$ for each $v \in V$, such that the inequality $\operatorname{ht}_{\omega_X} \lesssim (1+\epsilon)\cdot\operatorname{log\text{-}diff}_X$ is false on $\Xi$, and, moreover, the [unordered] $d$-tuples of $\mathbb{Q}$-conjugates of points $\in \Xi$ converge, as [unordered] $d$-tuples of points of $X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}_v)$, to $\Xi_v$.

The intervening step:

> Moreover, by the main result of [Mzk1] [cf. [Mzk1], Theorem 2.5], there exists a “noncritical Belyi map”
> $$
> \phi : X \to P
> $$
> which is unramified over $U_P$, and, moreover, “noncritical” at the points of each $\Xi_v$ [i.e., maps the points of each $\Xi_v$ into $U_P(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}_v)$].

The resulting compactly bounded image:

> In particular, [after possibly eliminating finitely many elements from $\Xi$] it follows that there exists a compactly bounded subset $\mathcal{K}_V \subseteq U_P(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ [i.e., whose bounding domains are the unions of Galois-conjugates of images via $\phi$ of sufficiently small compact neighborhoods of the points of $\Xi_v$ in $X(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}_v)$, for $v \in V$] such that $\phi(\Xi)\subseteq\mathcal{K}_V$.

The paper supplies the compactness argument in the proof of Theorem 2.1: it passes to a subset of points of fixed degree d whose unordered conjugate d-tuples converge to local algebraic points, then uses a noncritical Belyi map to obtain a compactly bounded image. The explicit bounded-degree subsequence construction, quantification over all embeddings, and the precise target of the current localCompactness unit are established by the formal Heights source proof. These are a formal elaboration of the cited argument; the quoted paragraph is not a verbatim statement of the current formal auxiliary theorem. The paper passage uses a subset Xi and convergence of unordered tuples; it does not itself display a sequence-indexed subsequence or an explicit all-embeddings formula.

Exact English wording checked visually against rendered PDF page 12. Original mathematics is represented in LaTeX; line wrapping and typographic emphasis normalized. The a(n) wording and bracketed words are retained as printed.

Existing official PDF reused; no download, workspace edits, or compilation.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.localCompactness`

For a natural number $N$, let $M$ be the following model: $K$ is an intermediate field of $\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(\mathbb Q(t))/\mathbb Q$, with elements $u,v\in K$ such that $u$ is transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$, and $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ is finite dimensional with dimension $N$. Here $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ is the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q$, and $\kappa(O)$ denotes the residue field of a valuation ring $O$. A place $P$ is a proper valuation subring $O_P\subsetneq K$ containing every rational number. A point $x=(P_x,s_x)$ also specifies a unital ring embedding $s_x:\kappa(O_{P_x})\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$; its full point field is $F_x=s_x(\kappa(O_{P_x}))$ and its degree is $\dim_{\mathbb Q}F_x$. Assume every residue field $\kappa(O_P)$ is finite dimensional over $\mathbb Q$. Assume also that every $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring. For every natural degree bound $d$ and sequence $(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ of these points with $\dim_{\mathbb Q}F_{x_n}\le d$ for every $n$, there exist a strictly increasing $D:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ and a finite set $T$ of places of $K$ with this property: for every $\varphi\in K$ with $\varphi\ne0$, $\varphi\ne1$, and $\varphi,\varphi^{-1},(\varphi-1)^{-1}\in O_P$ for every $P\in T$, there is a real constant $C$ such that for every sufficiently large $n$ there is a membership witness $h_n:\varphi\in O_{P_{x_{D(n)}}}$. Writing $e_n=s_{x_{D(n)}}(\rho_{x_{D(n)}}(\langle\varphi,h_n\rangle))\in F_{x_{D(n)}}$, its image in $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ is neither $0$ nor $1$; for every unital ring embedding $\sigma:F_{x_{D(n)}}\to\mathbb C$ one has $|\log\|\sigma(e_n)\||\le C$ and $|\log\|\sigma(e_n)-1\||\le C$; and for every unital ring embedding $\tau:F_{x_{D(n)}}\to\overline{\mathbb Q_2}$ one has $|\log\|\tau(e_n)\||\le C$ and $|\log\|\tau(e_n)-1\||\le C$, using the respective complex and $p$-adic algebraic-closure norms. The same $D$ and $T$ serve all eligible $\varphi$; $C$ and the eventual index threshold may depend on $\varphi$, but are common to all the indicated embeddings. The embedding domains are the full fields $F_{x_{D(n)}}$, not merely the fields generated by $e_n$. The set $T$ may be empty. The finite-prime support is exactly $\{2\}$. The degree hypotheses cannot hold for $d=0$.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.localCompactness`

给定自然数 $N$，设 $M$ 为如下模型：$K$ 是 $\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(\mathbb Q(t))/\mathbb Q$ 的中间域，含元素 $u,v\in K$，其中 $u$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上超越，$u^N+v^N=1$，$\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$，且 $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ 为有限维扩张，维数等于 $N$。这里 $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 为固定的 $\mathbb Q$ 的代数闭包，$\kappa(O)$ 表示赋值环 $O$ 的剩余域。处 $P$ 指包含所有有理数的真赋值子环 $O_P\subsetneq K$。点 $x=(P_x,s_x)$ 还指定剩余域的含幺环嵌入 $s_x:\kappa(O_{P_x})\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$；其完整点域为 $F_x=s_x(\kappa(O_{P_x}))$，次数为 $\dim_{\mathbb Q}F_x$。 假设每个剩余域 $\kappa(O_P)$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上有限维。 另假设每个 $O_P$ 都是离散赋值环。 对每个自然数次数上界 $d$ 和每项满足 $\dim_{\mathbb Q}F_{x_n}\le d$ 的上述点序列 $(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$，存在严格递增的 $D:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ 及 $K$ 的处的有限集 $T$，使得：对每个满足 $\varphi\ne0$、$\varphi\ne1$ 且对所有 $P\in T$ 都有 $\varphi,\varphi^{-1},(\varphi-1)^{-1}\in O_P$ 的 $\varphi\in K$，存在实常数 $C$，使每个充分大的 $n$ 都有隶属见证 $h_n:\varphi\in O_{P_{x_{D(n)}}}$。记 $e_n=s_{x_{D(n)}}(\rho_{x_{D(n)}}(\langle\varphi,h_n\rangle))\in F_{x_{D(n)}}$，则它在 $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 中的像不等于 $0$ 或 $1$；对每个含幺环嵌入 $\sigma:F_{x_{D(n)}}\to\mathbb C$，有 $|\log\|\sigma(e_n)\||\le C$ 及 $|\log\|\sigma(e_n)-1\||\le C$；对每个含幺环嵌入 $\tau:F_{x_{D(n)}}\to\overline{\mathbb Q_2}$，有 $|\log\|\tau(e_n)\||\le C$ 及 $|\log\|\tau(e_n)-1\||\le C$，其中分别使用复数范数和 $p$ 进代数闭包上的范数。所有合适的 $\varphi$ 共用同一个 $D$ 和同一个 $T$；$C$ 及最终成立的指标起点可依赖 $\varphi$，但所有指定嵌入共用它们。嵌入的定义域为完整的 $F_{x_{D(n)}}$，而不只是 $e_n$ 生成的域。允许 $T$ 为空。有限素数支撑恰为 $\{2\}$。$d=0$ 时次数前提不可能成立。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.localCompactness`

自然数 $N$ に対し、$M$ を次の模型とする。$K$ は $\operatorname{AlgebraicClosure}(\mathbb Q(t))/\mathbb Q$ の中間体であり、元 $u,v\in K$ は、$u$ が $\mathbb Q$ 上超越的であること、$u^N+v^N=1$、$\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$、および $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ が有限次元でその次元が $N$ であることを満たす。ここで $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ は固定した $\mathbb Q$ の代数閉包、$\kappa(O)$ は付値環 $O$ の剰余体である。素点 $P$ はすべての有理数を含む真の付値部分環 $O_P\subsetneq K$ である。点 $x=(P_x,s_x)$ はさらに剰余体の単位的環埋め込み $s_x:\kappa(O_{P_x})\to\overline{\mathbb Q}$ を指定し、その全点体は $F_x=s_x(\kappa(O_{P_x}))$、次数は $\dim_{\mathbb Q}F_x$ である。 各剰余体 $\kappa(O_P)$ は $\mathbb Q$ 上有限次元と仮定する。 さらに、各 $O_P$ は離散付値環と仮定する。 各自然数の次数上界 $d$ と、すべての $n$ で $\dim_{\mathbb Q}F_{x_n}\le d$ を満たす上記の点の列 $(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ に対し、狭義単調増加写像 $D:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ と $K$ の素点の有限集合 $T$ が存在し、次が成り立つ。$\varphi\ne0$、$\varphi\ne1$、およびすべての $P\in T$ で $\varphi,\varphi^{-1},(\varphi-1)^{-1}\in O_P$ を満たす各 $\varphi\in K$ に対し、実定数 $C$ が存在し、十分大きいすべての $n$ について所属の証拠 $h_n:\varphi\in O_{P_{x_{D(n)}}}$ が存在する。$e_n=s_{x_{D(n)}}(\rho_{x_{D(n)}}(\langle\varphi,h_n\rangle))\in F_{x_{D(n)}}$ と書くと、その $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ における像は $0$ でも $1$ でもなく、各単位的環埋め込み $\sigma:F_{x_{D(n)}}\to\mathbb C$ について $|\log\|\sigma(e_n)\||\le C$ および $|\log\|\sigma(e_n)-1\||\le C$ が成り立ち、各単位的環埋め込み $\tau:F_{x_{D(n)}}\to\overline{\mathbb Q_2}$ について $|\log\|\tau(e_n)\||\le C$ および $|\log\|\tau(e_n)-1\||\le C$ が成り立つ。ノルムはそれぞれ複素数のノルムと $p$ 進体の代数閉包のノルムである。同じ $D,T$ がすべての該当する $\varphi$ に用いられる。$C$ と最終的に成立する添字の下限は $\varphi$ に依存してよいが、指定されたすべての埋め込みに共通である。埋め込みの定義域は全体の $F_{x_{D(n)}}$ であり、$e_n$ の生成する体だけではない。$T$ は空でもよい。有限素数の台はちょうど $\{2\}$ である。$d=0$ では次数の仮定は成立しない。
